final_topology.title: Financial Data Ingestion Network
final_topology.description: A network designed for ingesting financial data feeds and processing them in dedicated market data pods, with outputs distributed to three campus sites.
final_topology.topology_summary: The network includes dedicated pods for data ingestion and processing, connected to three campus sites via trunk links for inter-site communication. Segmentation is enforced by function.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zones and nodes, and there are specific nodes labeled as 'Asset Management System' and 'Asset Management System 2', which strongly imply the presence of an asset management system. Additionally, there are numerous management links from these systems to various nodes, indicating that asset management is being performed.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes numerous data flow links between nodes, such as 'Ingestion to Feed Handler 1', 'Feed Handler 1 to Analytics Workload 1', etc., which strongly imply that data flows are documented.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for different functions, such as 'Ingestion Pod', 'Market Data Pod 1', 'Market Data Pod 2', 'Security Zone', 'Non-Production Zone', etc., which indicates that data processing and storage are segmented based on sensitivity.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes firewalls (Firewall 1 and Firewall 2) in the 'Security Zone' and there are data flow links from these firewalls to various nodes, indicating that firewalls are implemented and managed.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a DNS server in the 'Security Zone' and there are data flow links from this DNS server to various nodes, indicating that trusted DNS servers are configured on enterprise assets.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an MFA/Identity Server in the 'Management Zone' and there are management links from this server to various nodes, indicating that MFA is required for remote network access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a DNS Filter in the 'Security Zone' and there are data flow links from this DNS Filter to various nodes, indicating that DNS filtering services are used.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Web Proxy in the 'Security Zone' and there are data flow links from this Web Proxy to various nodes, indicating that network-based URL filters are maintained and enforced.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for different functions, such as 'Ingestion Pod', 'Market Data Pod 1', 'Market Data Pod 2', 'Security Zone', 'Non-Production Zone', etc., and there are numerous links between these zones, indicating that a secure network architecture is established and maintained.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes nodes such as switches, routers, and firewalls, and there are management links from the 'Management Zone' to these nodes, indicating that network infrastructure is securely managed.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Central AAA Server in the 'Management Zone' and there are management links from this server to various nodes, indicating that network AAA is centralized.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a VPN Gateway in the 'Security Zone' and there are management links from this gateway to the 'Bastion Host' and 'Admin Workstation', indicating that remote devices utilize a VPN and connect to the enterprise’s AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a NIDS in the 'Security Zone' and there are monitoring links from this NIDS to various nodes, indicating that a network intrusion detection solution is deployed.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes firewalls (Firewall 1 and Firewall 2) in the 'Security Zone' and there are data flow links from these firewalls to various nodes, indicating that traffic filtering between network segments is performed.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Central AAA Server in the 'Management Zone' and there are management links from this server to various nodes, indicating that access control for remote assets is managed.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Log Collector in the 'Log Collection Zone' and there are data flow links from this log collector to various nodes, indicating that network traffic flow logs are collected.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Non-Production Zone' and there are structural links from this zone to other zones, indicating that production and non-production systems are separated.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Pen Test Workstation and a Pen Test Results Repository in the 'External Testing Zone', and there are data flow links between these nodes, indicating that periodic external penetration tests are performed.

findings_before.title: empty_zone_without_node
findings_before.missing_reason: Zone z9 has no concrete node assigned to it.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add one representative concrete node in this zone and connect it with node_links to the nearest hub, firewall, router, or management/security node.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various nodes and zones, but there is no explicit evidence of a detailed and up-to-date inventory of all enterprise assets, including their network addresses, hardware addresses, machine names, asset owners, and departments.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of a detailed asset inventory.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset management system or provide documentation of the asset inventory.

findings_before.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a Bastion Host (n22) and an Admin Workstation (n23) that likely use a VPN, but there is no explicit evidence of a VPN in the topology.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of a VPN.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a VPN gateway and links to remote devices.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes an External Testing Zone (z10) with a Pen Test Workstation (n24), but there is no explicit evidence of periodic external penetration tests.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of periodic external penetration tests.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add documentation or a node representing the results of periodic external penetration tests.
